Loops written for four MODX+ drum kits, sent straight to the board over USB. Use them to hear the congas, bongos, timbales,
bells and brushes, and mark the ones you'd use with ☆. Works in Chrome or Edge (Web MIDI). The key maps come from Yamaha's
MODX6+/7+/8+ Data List (Drum Kit Assign List); the grooves are this site's own sketches of each style, not transcriptions.

## Brushes (Real Brushes, Jazz Brushes, Brush Kit)

```{=html}
<p class="mp-note">Every brush loop uses keys that mean the same thing on all three kits, so <b>⇄ Take turns</b> plays it on each
kit in turn (two bars each) and you can hear which you like.</p>

```
